hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ "$FILE" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/SKILL.md" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills/which-model" && cp "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/SKILL.md" "$HOME/.claude/skills/which-model/SKILL.md" && echo 'which-model: SKILL.md synced to ~/.claude/skills/which-model/SKILL.md'; fi
